plate_comment: Boot / restart reset of the engine protection shutdown (cm848_applicationMain, cm848_restartApplicationWithoutReset, hpcr_initializeEngineProtection): clears the approaching and command flags, the latch, the previous engine speed, the shutdown time counts, the override request and lamp flags and the timer state, and records the shutdown channel at power-up (engine_protection_power_up_shutdown_channel). It is not part of an engine start sequence (was cm848_completeEngineStartSequence)

Boot / restart reset of the pre-crank examination: clears engine_protection_precrank_shutdown_command_flag and the fuel temperature channel's precrank_error. It touches no sensor channel (was cm848_initSensorChannelDataStructures)
Boot / init reset of cm848_detectEngineProtectionShutdownOverrideRequest's state: the switch's previous state and the pending request (was exception_resetProtectionModeState)

Looks the fault derate fuel limit up at the five J1939 torque curve speed points and lowers the J1939 torque curve fuelings (PGN 65251) to them: always where the clamp mask (fault_derate_curve_clamp_priority_mask) has the highest requester's bit, else only while fault_derate_torque_curve_priority_bit is the highest request (was engine_protection_derateParam_priorityApply)

While the fault derate is active: sets fault_derate_torque_curve_priority_bit in j1939_pgn65251_speed_points_request_flags and, if no higher request is set, computes the J1939 torque curve speed points (point 1 from the low speed governor reference speed less its droop correction, the next from the engine speed limit and its droop) (was governor_calculateIntegratorRpmOutput)

Sets fault_derate_torque_curve_priority_bit from fault_derate_curve_priority_bit_position (e2m EPF_Torque_Curve_Priority) and presets fault_derate_torque_curve_points_cached_axis_offset to 2 (was fault_initBitwiseTimerMask)
